description: Inside a Sales voucher, Ctrl+H opens the unified Change Mode picker (TallyPrime replaced ERP9's Alt+I / Ctrl+V two-axis toggles) and offers the INVOICE family, not single/double entry. Item Invoice and Accounting Invoice are both real; 'As Voucher' (keying an invoice as raw Dr/Cr lines) is genuinely not built and is still listed saying so — the same honesty the keymap applies to unavailable combos, because a key that silently does nothing is what makes a keyboard user distrust the app.
